title: Too much blank space in panel popup
line: Clicking a panel Timer that only shows a progress bar now opens a popup with the time, instead of a big empty one.
explanation: The Timer's popup hid its digits whenever 'Show remaining time' was off, although that option is meant for what the panel shows. With only the progress bar enabled, the panel popup was a large empty area with one thin bar and the time could not be set there. The change keeps the digits visible in the popup of a panel timer, as in the open MR kdeplasma-addons!1235; desktop timers still follow the option.

commits.message:
applets/timer: always show the time in the panel popup

"Show remaining time" decides what the panel shows. With it off, the popup
was a big empty area around a thin progress bar and the time couldn't be
set. The popup of a panel timer now always shows the digits.

BUG: 488937

patches.diff:
From a4e06693b23b8708489897db231e64ff2ad5a918 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:34:49 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/timer: always show the time in the panel popup

"Show remaining time" decides what the panel shows. With it off, the popup
was a big empty area around a thin progress bar and the time couldn't be
set. The popup of a panel timer now always shows the digits.

BUG: 488937
---
 applets/timer/TimerView.qml | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applets/timer/TimerView.qml b/applets/timer/TimerView.qml
index dc1f94e40..d50b72461 100644
--- a/applets/timer/TimerView.qml
+++ b/applets/timer/TimerView.qml
@@ -89,7 +89,7 @@ MouseArea {
             Layout.fillWidth: true
             Layout.fillHeight: true
             Layout.verticalStretchFactor: 3
-            visible: Plasmoid.configuration.showRemainingTime
+            visible: Plasmoid.configuration.showRemainingTime || fullRepresentation.inPanel
 
             value: fullRepresentation.seconds
             editable: !fullRepresentation.running
--
